title: INV-001 Add a new medicine
steps:
Open Medicines > New
Enter name, generic name, strength, dosage form, manufacturer, HSN, GST %, MRP and reorder level
Click Save
expected_result: Medicine is saved, appears in the list with a unique code

title: INV-002 Mandatory fields are enforced
steps:
Open Medicines > New
Leave name or MRP empty
Click Save
expected_result: Validation errors are shown and nothing is saved

title: INV-003 Duplicate medicine is rejected
steps:
Add the same name, strength and manufacturer a second time
Click Save
expected_result: Second save is rejected with a duplicate message

title: INV-004 Zero or negative MRP is rejected
steps:
Enter MRP -5, save
Enter MRP 0, save
expected_result: Both values are rejected

title: INV-005 Flag controlled / Schedule H drug
steps:
Tick Schedule H or Narcotic on a medicine
Save
expected_result: Flag is saved; dispensing later requires a prescription

title: INV-006 Search by name, generic name and barcode
steps:
Search 'para'
Search 'paracetamol'
Scan the barcode
expected_result: The correct medicine is returned for each search

title: INV-010 Add a batch with expiry
steps:
Add stock with batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, quantity and purchase price
Save
expected_result: Batch is created and linked to the medicine

title: INV-011 Expiry before manufacture date is rejected
steps:
Enter an expiry date earlier than the manufacture date
Save
expected_result: Entry is rejected with a clear message

title: INV-012 Already expired batch cannot be received
steps: Receive a batch whose expiry date is in the past
expected_result: Blocked or warned; it cannot be added to sellable stock

title: INV-013 Same batch number received twice
steps: Receive batch B123 again
expected_result: Quantity merges into the batch or a clear conflict is shown; no duplicate batch

title: INV-014 Near-expiry alerts
preconditions: Batches expiring in 30, 60 and 90 days exist
steps: Open the near-expiry list
expected_result: All three batches appear with the correct days left

title: INV-015 FEFO batch selection
preconditions: Two batches with stock; one expires earlier
steps: Dispense the medicine
expected_result: The earlier-expiry batch is used first

title: INV-016 Expired batch is blocked from sale
preconditions: A batch passes its expiry date
steps: Try to sell from that batch
expected_result: Batch is excluded from sale and listed under expired stock

title: INV-020 Receive stock against a purchase order
steps:
Create a GRN for the PO with the full quantity
Save
expected_result: Stock increases, PO closes and a GRN number is generated

title: INV-021 Partial receipt keeps PO open
steps: Receive less than the ordered quantity
expected_result: Stock increases by the received amount; PO stays open with the balance

title: INV-022 Over-receipt is controlled
steps: Receive more than the ordered quantity
expected_result: A warning is shown or the entry is blocked per policy

title: INV-023 Return damaged goods to supplier
steps: Create a supplier return for damaged quantity
expected_result: Stock decreases and a debit note is created

title: INV-030 Stock decreases on sale
steps: Sell 5 units of the batch
expected_result: On-hand quantity reduces by exactly 5

title: INV-031 Cannot sell more than available
steps: Try to sell 10 units
expected_result: Sale is blocked with an insufficient stock message

title: INV-032 Manual adjustment records a reason
steps:
Adjust stock by -2 with reason 'damaged'
Save
expected_result: Stock reduces; entry stores user, time and reason

title: INV-033 Adjustment without reason is rejected
steps: Save an adjustment with the reason left blank
expected_result: Entry is rejected

title: INV-034 Transfer stock between stores
steps: Transfer 10 units from store A to store B
expected_result: Store A is reduced by 10; store B increases by 10 once accepted; in-transit state is visible

title: INV-035 Customer return goes back to stock
steps: Process a return within the return policy
expected_result: Stock increases in the correct batch with a sellable-condition check

title: INV-040 Low-stock alert
steps: Reduce stock below the reorder level
expected_result: Item appears in the low-stock list and raises an alert

title: INV-041 Zero stock display
steps: Sell down to zero units
expected_result: Item shows Out of stock and cannot be sold

title: INV-050 Stock audit variance needs approval
steps: Enter a physical count that differs from the system quantity
expected_result: Variance is calculated and the adjustment requires approval

title: INV-051 Role-based access
steps:
Log in as pharmacist and try to edit prices and approve adjustments
Repeat as store manager
expected_result: Pharmacist is blocked; manager is allowed

title: INV-052 Audit trail for price change
steps:
Edit a medicine price
Open its audit history
expected_result: User, time, old value and new value are recorded and visible

title: INV-053 Stock valuation report
steps: Run the stock valuation report
expected_result: Totals equal quantity x purchase price per batch

title: INV-054 Expiry report export
steps: Export the near-expiry report to CSV
expected_result: File opens with the correct columns and rows

title: INV-055 Concurrent sale of last unit
steps: Two users sell the last unit at the same time
expected_result: One sale succeeds, the other gets insufficient stock; stock never goes negative

title: INV-056 Search speed on a large catalogue
steps: Search for a common term
expected_result: Results are returned in under 2 seconds
